founder.p1: I believe chess should not feel like a complicated subject that only a few people can understand.
founder.p2: I wanted to create a place where anyone can start from zero, make mistakes without fear, laugh while learning, and slowly become better.
founder.p3: FunnyChess was created with one simple idea: Make chess easier to start, more fun to learn, and more enjoyable to play.
founder.storyText: FunnyChess started with a blank editor, ₹0 initial budget, and a mission: why should learning chess feel like a boring exam? Using open-source technologies, client-side engines, and sheer passion, it was created so anyone can learn, laugh, and master chess completely free.
founder.adviceText: Stop worrying about memorizing 20-move opening theories. The real magic of chess is tactical play: active knights, solid king defense, and laughing off your blunders. Make your first move today!
founder.favMove: Founder's Favorite: ♘ Nf3 — Flexible, active, and controls the center!
founder.botBanter: “Somnath coded me to be witty, but your moves make my punchlines too easy!” 😂
founder.quote: “You don't need to be a chess master to start. You just need to make your first move.”
founder.author: — Somnath Sen, Founder & Creator, FunnyChess
founder.freePledge: Built free-first ❤️ with open-source technology and a ₹0 initial budget.
